categories.name: Niños
categories.desc: Juegos para los más pequeños: letras, números, música.

categories.name: Juegos
categories.desc: Carreras y pesca en 3D, ajedrez, puzles y clásicos.

categories.name: Consolas retro
categories.desc: Consolas clasicas: juegos de WASM-4, Game Boy, Arduboy y CHIP-8, todos libres.

categories.name: Productividad
categories.desc: Temporizadores, paneles y herramientas para el escritorio.

categories.name: Hogar
categories.desc: Controla luces, enchufes y sensores de tu red.

categories.name: Terminal
categories.desc: Programas para la Terminal: Lua, JavaScript, BASIC, SQLite, aventuras de texto.

apps.name: JavaScript
apps.author: QuickJS-ng project (Bellard, Gordon, contributors)
apps.description: JavaScript moderno (ES2024) con QuickJS-ng: prompt interactivo, scripts y modulos, archivos, temporizadores. Escribe js o js archivo.js.

apps.name: Lua
apps.author: Lua.org, PUC-Rio
apps.description: Lua 5.4 en el Terminal: prompt interactivo y scripts. Escribe lua, o lua script.lua para un archivo de /sdcard/home.

apps.name: SQLite
apps.author: SQLite developers (D. Richard Hipp et al.)
apps.description: La shell de SQLite: bases de datos SQL locales en la tarjeta SD, con JSON y funciones matematicas. Escribe sqlite3 notas.db.

apps.name: ABC 123
apps.description: Aprende letras y números con 7 minijuegos. Multilingüe, con voz.

apps.name: Ajedrez
apps.author: NucleoOS
apps.description: Chess against the computer, powered by the mcu-max engine. You play white: tap a piece, then its square. Three levels, undo, check, mate and draw rules, and your game is saved.

apps.name: Cannon
apps.description: Artillery arcade: drag your finger to set angle and power, lift it to fire.

apps.name: CHIP-8 Arcade
apps.author: NucleoOS; games by the CHIP-8 Community Archive authors
apps.description: 83 juegos homebrew del CHIP-8 Community Archive (CC0) en una consola CHIP-8 / SUPER-CHIP / XO-CHIP.

apps.name: Devices
apps.author: NucleoOS
apps.description: Shelly, WLED y Tasmota en tu Wi-Fi, detectados solos: enciendelos y apagalos con un toque. Sin Home Assistant ni nube.

apps.name: Doom Engine
apps.author: NucleoOS (doomgeneric, Chocolate Doom, emu8950)
apps.description: El motor clásico de Doom (doomgeneric, de Chocolate Doom) ajustado a esta placa: imagen 4:3, música OPL, teclado, ratón y mandos. Ejecuta los juegos Doom de la Store y tus propios WAD.

apps.name: Home
apps.author: NucleoOS
apps.description: Home Assistant en el panel: luces, enchufes, persianas, termostatos, cerraduras, escenas y sensores por habitacion. Configura URL y token en Ajustes > Hogar.

apps.name: openHASP
apps.author: openHASP contributors (HASwitchPlate)
apps.description: openHASP (HASwitchPlate): touch pages for Home Assistant described in JSONL and driven over MQTT. Works with the openHASP integration from HACS.

apps.name: Pianino
apps.description: Un piano infantil colorido: teclas de arcoíris y cuatro instrumentos.

apps.name: Pomodoro Desk Hub
apps.description: Panel de escritorio inteligente de 7 pulgadas: temporizador Pomodoro, calendario mensual y modo noche tenue.

apps.name: Puzzles
apps.author: Simon Tatham et al.
apps.description: La coleccion de Simon Tatham: 40 rompecabezas de logica (Bridges, Keen, Light Up, Loopy, Mines, Net, Solo...). Deshacer, solucion y partidas guardadas. MIT.

apps.name: Tiempo
apps.description: Clima y pronósticos en tiempo real con Open-Meteo, geolocalización, ajustes y diseño visual.

apps.name: Timer
apps.description: Cronometro y cuenta atras con pitido final. Digitos grandes.

apps.name: Vertice Bass
apps.author: NucleoOS
apps.description: Torneo de pesca arcade en 3D: seis lagos, ocho especies, tres senuelos, peleas con tension de sedal y un muro con tus diez peces mas grandes.
apps.notes: Boat you drive with the d-pad, lake select with unlocks, livewell scoring, harder fights, and key hints when a keyboard or gamepad is plugged in.

apps.name: Vertice GP
apps.author: NucleoOS
apps.description: Karts en 3D con el motor Vertice: cuatro karts, tres vueltas, turbo en derrape, monedas y rebufo. Táctil, teclado o mando.

apps.name: Zigbee
apps.author: NucleoOS
apps.description: Zigbee2MQTT en el panel: los dispositivos aparecen solos; enciende luces y enchufes y mira sensores. Requiere el broker MQTT en Ajustes > Hogar.

apps.name: Zork I-III
apps.author: Infocom / Microsoft; MojoZork by Ryan C. Gordon
apps.description: Zork I, II y III, las aventuras de texto clasicas de 1980 (en ingles), libres con licencia MIT. Escribe zork en el Terminal, o zork 2 para Zork II.

apps.name: BASIC
apps.author: Adam Dunkels (uBASIC), Nucleo port
apps.description: BASIC clasico con lineas numeradas: print/if/goto/gosub/for-next/input. Escribe basic prog.bas para un programa de /sdcard/home. Palabras clave en minuscula, variables a-z.

apps.name: bc calculator
apps.author: Gavin D. Howard and contributors
apps.description: bc, the arbitrary-precision calculator: numbers with as many digits as you want, functions, and a math library (bc -l). Type bc and write expressions like 2^200 or sqrt(2).

apps.name: Berry
apps.author: Guan Wenliang and the Berry contributors
apps.description: Berry, a small object-oriented scripting language for microcontrollers: interactive prompt and scripts. Type berry for the prompt, berry script.be to run a file from /sdcard/home.

apps.name: FIGlet
apps.author: Glenn Chappell, Ian Chai, John Cowan, Christiaan Keet, Claudio Matsuoka
apps.description: FIGlet writes text in big letters made of characters, with 15 built-in fonts. Type figlet Hello, or figlet -f slant Hello; figlet --list shows the fonts.

apps.name: Game Boy
apps.author: Peanut-GB by Mahyar Koshkouei, MiniGB APU by Alex Baines; NucleoOS
apps.description: Game Boy player (Peanut-GB, MIT): plays your own .gb games from /sdcard/home/roms with touch controls, gamepads, sound and battery saves. Homebrew: hh.gbdev.io.

apps.name: Glulxe
apps.author: Andrew Plotkin (Glulxe, CheapGlk)
apps.description: Ficcion interactiva moderna (Inform 7 / Glulx) en el Terminal. Copia una historia .gblorb o .ulx a /sdcard/home y escribe glulxe historia.gblorb.

apps.name: jq
apps.author: Stephen Dolan and the jq contributors (regex: Oniguruma, K. Kosako)
apps.description: jq, the command-line JSON processor: filter, transform and pretty-print JSON files, with regular expressions. Type jq '.name' data.json, or pipe JSON into it.

apps.name: JSON
apps.author: Dave Gamble and cJSON contributors
apps.description: Valida, formatea, comprime y consulta archivos JSON: cjson file.json, cjson -c file.json (compacto), cjson -q .foo.bar file.json.

apps.name: Markdown
apps.author: Martin Mitá (md4c)
apps.description: Convierte Markdown a HTML: md notas.md (HTML en stdout), md -f -o out.html notas.md (documento completo), md --gfm (tablas/tachado/listas al estilo GitHub).

apps.name: pForth
apps.author: Phil Burk, Larry Polansky, David Rosenboom
apps.description: pForth, a portable ANS Forth: stack-based interactive programming, with floating point and file words. Type pforth for the prompt, pforth file.fth to load a file.

apps.name: Scheme
apps.author: Dimitrios Souflis, Kevin Cozens and the TinyScheme contributors
apps.description: TinyScheme, a small Scheme (R5RS subset): interactive prompt and scripts, with 64-bit integers, floats, strings, vectors and files. Type scheme for the prompt, scheme file.scm to run a file.

apps.name: Synth
apps.author: NucleoOS + AMY (Brian Whitman, Dan Ellis)
apps.description: Polyphonic synthesizer on the AMY engine: 128 Juno-106 and 128 DX7 patches plus a piano. Two-octave multi-touch keyboard, ten presets, volume, tone and reverb.

apps.name: Tcl
apps.author: Steve Bennett, Salvatore Sanfilippo and the Jim Tcl contributors
apps.description: Tcl in the Terminal (Jim Tcl): interactive prompt and scripts, with lists, dicts, regexp, OO and file I/O. Type tcl for the prompt, tcl script.tcl to run a file.

apps.name: Wren
apps.author: Robert Nystrom and the Wren contributors
apps.description: Wren, a small, fast class-based scripting language: interactive prompt and scripts, with a mini io module (Stdin, File). Type wren for the prompt, wren script.wren to run a file.

apps.name: Zip
apps.author: Rich Geldreich and contributors (miniz)
apps.description: Crea, lista y extrae archivos .zip: zip archivo.zip file1 file2 (crear), zip -l archivo.zip (listar), zip -x archivo.zip [dir] (extraer).
